title: Nymphia Wind wins Season 16
summary: In the Grand Finale (US-S16-E16), Nymphia Wind was crowned America's Next Drag Superstar after a Lip Sync for the Crown to "Padam Padam" against Sapphira Cristál. Plane Jane placed third after the final three cut. The Season 16 cash prize was $200,000.

title: Sapphira Cristál and Xunami Muse tie for Miss Congeniality
summary: At the Grand Finale (US-S16-E16), Season 16 announced a tied Miss Congeniality between Sapphira Cristál and Xunami Muse — the first dual Miss Congeniality title on the main US series. The season record flags Sapphira Cristál as missCongenialityId.

title: Hershii LiqCour-Jeté is Season 16's porkchop
summary: On The Mother of All Balls (US-S16-E03), Hershii LiqCour-Jeté lip-synced against Geneva Karr to Ava Max's "Maybe You're the Problem" and was the first queen eliminated, becoming Season 16's porkchop.
